name: seedance-2-5-video-director
title_zh: 把即梦 Seedance 2.5 的脚本改到能直接出
tagline_zh: 写分镜、卡时间轴、调转场、修对话，全按 Seedance 2.5 的脾气来。30 秒到 3 分钟的长视频。
tagline_en: From rough idea to production-ready prompts for Seedance 2.5 — timelines, transitions, dialogue, multi-grid.
desc_en: Design, derive, optimize, diagnose, and rewrite scripts or copy-ready prompts specifically for Dreamina/即梦 Seedance 2.5. Use for new text/image/video/audio-to-video concepts, exact-timeline videos, 30-180-second Long Video, extension, video editing, Clay Renderer, seamless transitions, multi-grid storyboards, realistic acted dialogue, relationship drama, sports or variety-show live camera grammar,
why_zh: 不是通用提示词模板，而是把 Seedance 2.5 的渲染器特性（Clay、多格。
why_en: Not generic prompt advice — it encodes Seedance 2.5's renderer quirks (Clay, multi-grid, live-camera grammar) into derivation.
limit_zh: 只认即梦/Seedance 2.5 这一个模型，换到别的视频模型（如 Kling、Runway）推导出的提示词会水土不。
limit_en: Tuned exclusively for Dreamina/Seedance 2.5; prompts won't transfer to other video models. Outputs scripts/prompts only — no video generation, stops.
